name: Hot Chocolate (Orange)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 oz (110 g) bittersweet chocolate, chopped (can substitute semisweet)

steps: Place the milk and cinnamon in a saucepan, and gently heat to just below a simmer, about 180 F.
Add the chocolate, and stir while allowing to melt. Do not allow to come to a boil.
When the chocolate has melted, strain the chocolate milk into another container, add the extracts, and whisk or blend until frothy.
Transfer to mugs or heatproof glasses and serve.

culture.text: Chocolate is a food made from roasted and ground cocoa beans. It can be a liquid, solid, or paste. It is eaten on its own and used to flavor other foods.
